items.source: For style-based formatting, set the style() attribute to the desired NumberFormat.Style. For custom formatting, set the pattern() attribute to the desired number pattern, such as "#,###.##".
items.translation: 对于基于样式的格式化，将 `style()` 属性设置为所需的NumberFormat.Style。对于自定义格式化，将 `pattern()` 属性设置为所需的数字模式，例如"#,###.##"。

items.source: Each attribute is mutually exclusive, so only set one attribute per annotation (the one most convenient for your formatting needs). When the pattern() attribute is specified, it takes precedence over the style() attribute. When no annotation attributes are specified, the default format applied is style-based for either number or currency, depending on the annotated field or method parameter type.
items.translation: 每个属性是互斥的，因此每个注解中只能设置一个属性（选择最适合您格式化需求的属性）。当指定 `pattern()` 属性时，它将优先于 `style()` 属性。当未指定任何注解属性时，默认应用基于样式的格式，具体取决于被注解的字段或方法参数类型是数字还是货币。

items.source: Supports formatting by style or custom pattern string. Can be applied to any JDK Number types such as Double and Long.
items.translation: 支持按样式或自定义模式字符串进行格式化。可应用于任何 JDK `` 数字类型，例如 ``Double` 和 ``Long。

items.source: Defaults to NumberFormat.Style.DEFAULT for general-purpose number formatting for most annotated types, except for money types which default to currency formatting.
items.translation: 默认为 `NumberFormat.Style.DEFAULT`，用于大多数带注解类型的通用数字格式化，但货币类型默认使用货币格式。

items.source:
Set this attribute when you wish to format your field or method parameter
in accordance with a common style other than the default style.
items.translation: 设置此属性时，您希望按照除默认样式之外的通用样式来格式化字段或方法参数。

items.source:
Defaults to an empty String, indicating no custom pattern has been
specified.
items.translation: 默认为空字符串，表示未指定自定义模式。

items.source:
Set this attribute when you wish to format your field or method parameter
in accordance with a custom number pattern not represented by a style.
items.translation: 设置此属性时，您希望按照自定义数字模式格式化字段或方法参数，该模式无法通过样式表示。

items.source: The custom pattern to use to format the field or method parameter.
items.translation: 用于格式化字段或方法参数的自定义模式。

items.source: The style pattern to use to format the field or method parameter.
items.translation: 用于格式化字段或方法参数的样式模式。
